quests.title: About This Modpack
quests.subtitle: Click for details and motivation!
desc: **This is a Skyblock Modpack based around rapid expandable progression.**

I wanted a skyblock modpack you could sit down, feel progression in, and "complete" your first time in around 10 hours without a plan. Then after that, optimize your pathing and get faster on future playthroughs.
The intial end goal is to beat the Ender Dragon of course, but strongholds only spawn on the moon! You will need to build a Rocket and make your way there to win the game.

Also on the moon is an optional boss and new materials which can be used to access new technology, rockets, and weapons. You'll be able to travel to more distant planets, finding new bosses to defeat and more materials to improve your factory. The defeat of the Ender Dragon is the soft ending, but the true ending is access to the /5/Creative/5/ factory components which will require defeating the bosses of every planet and a robust automated factory.
Inventory is kept on death by default because I think it's a artificial difficulty in skyblock. Maybe you think it's not, this can be changed in the config.

quests.title: Ad Astra
quests.subtitle: Core Mod 1: Space
desc: Ad Astra is the modern space travel mod, comparable to Galacticraft or whatever was in tekkit.

I wanted to try this mod the moment I found it, but it had the issue every space mod has - every planet is mostly empty, and you have no reason to engage with it beyond the intrinsic fun of making a rocket.

This is a core mod because I wanted to make it relevant to late game progression to make it feel worth using, rather than adding it as a kitchen sink style addition. Planets have currently been improved somewhat with some generation and structures, and making the resources found on each planet critical to tech advancement.

quests.title: Create: New Age
quests.subtitle: Core Mod 2: Electricity
desc: Create: New Age was the first mod I found and I used it on its own in a regular world and liked it a lot! I made it a core mod because I think the physical nature of the power generation, and heat generation, this mod adds novel and unique.

quests.title: Cataclysm
quests.subtitle: Core Mod 3: Boss Fights
desc: Cataclysm adds great boss fights and more materials to add more angles of progression. The bosses are scattered across several planets to let you make tech advancements with combat rather than just exploration and mining.
